To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the preconcentration and separation of chromium(VI), coupled with controllable synthesis of nano γ-alumina materials was achieved.
the γ-alumina nanomaterials were prepared by hydrothermal method of controlled synthesis.

(1) γ-Al2O was successfully synthesized via hydrothermal methods; (2) the preconcentration of Cr(VI), Sb, As, Cd, Ba, Pb, Hg and total Cr were explored in the presence of SDS and CTMBA; (3) the preconcentrated Cr(VI) was detected using ICP-MS.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation of nano γ-Al 2O3, the adsorption and preconcentration of Cr(VI).
the preconcentration performance for Cr(VI) using nano γ-Al2 O3 as adsorbent, which is a new approach for Cr(VI), and the results are significant in environmental monitoring
the preconcentration and separation of Cr(VI).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the method was feasible and effective for the preconcentration and separation of Cr(VI).
the method of preconcentration and separation of Cr(VI), which was coupled with controllable synthesis of nano γ-alumina, was a feasible way to analyze the content of Cr(VI).
the granular γ-AlO3 synthesized with SDS was more suitable for the preconcentration of Cr(VI).
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the preconcentration performance was good and the separation effect was better.
the adsorption of chromium(VI), the separation and the preconcentration were realized in one step.
the preconcentration and separation performance of Cr(VI), which was combined with controllable synthesis of nano γ-alumina materials, was better than the traditional method.
The main takeaway from our work is that
γ-Al2O 3 nano materials can be synthesized by a simple hydrothermal method and used as a preconcentration material to separate and detect Cr (VI) in environmental samples.
the preconcentration of Cr(VI), As(V), Sb(V), Se(VI) and total Cr in the environmental water samples was achieved by using the granular γ-AlO3 synthesized by hydrothermal method.
the adsorption capacity of granular γ-alumina for Cr(VI) was better than that for other heavy metal ions.
